title: AnthropicCLIOptions
description: Native Claude Code CLI arguments used by Captain's Anthropic CLI runtime.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Prompt text written to Claude Code standard input.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model alias or full model identifier passed to Claude Code.

systemPrompt.title: System prompt
systemPrompt.description: System prompt replacing Claude Code's default instructions.

appendSystemPrompt.title: Append system prompt
appendSystemPrompt.description: Additional instructions appended to Claude Code's system prompt.

resume.title: Resume session
resume.description: Session identifier resumed by Claude Code.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort requested from supported Claude models.

maxBudgetUsd.title: Maximum budget
maxBudgetUsd.description: Maximum spend in US dollars for the CLI request.

permissionMode.title: Permission mode
permissionMode.description: Claude Code permission posture translated from Captain policy.

allowedTools.title: Allowed tools
allowedTools.description: Claude Code tools allowed by Captain's tool policy.

disallowedTools.title: Disallowed tools
disallowedTools.description: Claude Code tools denied by Captain's tool policy.

addDir.title: Additional directories
addDir.description: Directories outside the working directory that Claude Code may access.

pluginDir.title: Plugin directories
pluginDir.description: Claude Code plugin directories loaded for this session.

disableSlashCommands.title: Disable slash commands
disableSlashCommands.description: Whether skills and slash commands are disabled.

bare.title: Bare mode
bare.description: Whether Claude starts without hooks, skills, plugins, or settings.

mcpConfig.title: MCP configuration
mcpConfig.description: MCP server configuration files or inline JSON passed to Claude Code.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Settings file or inline JSON generated for sandbox and monitoring behavior.

jsonSchema.title: JSON Schema
jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema constraining Claude's final response.

print.title: Print mode
print.description: Whether Claude prints one response and exits instead of opening an interactive session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain always invokes Claude Code in print mode.

verbose.title: Verbose
verbose.description: Whether Claude emits complete stream-json diagnostic events.

x-captain-option.note: Captain enables verbose output so the adapter receives the complete event stream.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: Format used for Claude Code output.

x-captain-option.note: Captain requires stream-json for typed event parsing.

strictMcpConfig.title: Strict MCP configuration
strictMcpConfig.description: Whether Claude uses only MCP servers supplied by --mcp-config.

x-captain-option.note: Captain enables strict MCP configuration whenever it supplies or disables MCP servers.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: Named agent selected for the current session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not select a named Claude Code agent.

agents.title: Agent definitions
agents.description: Inline JSON object defining custom agents.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose inline Claude Code agent definitions.

allowDangerouslySkipPermissions.title: Allow permission bypass
allowDangerouslySkipPermissions.description: Whether permission bypass may be selected without being the default mode.

x-captain-option.note: Captain expresses bypass through its validated permission-mode mapping.

autocompact.title: Autocompact
autocompact.description: Whether Claude compacts conversation context automatically.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not override Claude Code context compaction.

axScreenReader.title: Screen reader mode
axScreenReader.description: Whether terminal output is optimized for screen readers.

x-captain-option.note: Captain consumes machine-readable output and does not expose terminal accessibility flags.

background.title: Background mode
background.description: Whether the Claude Code session runs in the background.

x-captain-option.note: Captain supervises a foreground child process.

betas.title: Beta headers
betas.description: Anthropic beta feature identifiers included in API requests.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose per-run Claude beta headers.

brief.title: Brief mode
brief.description: Whether Claude emits a shorter initial response.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not enable Claude Code brief mode.

chrome.title: Chrome integration
chrome.description: Whether Claude Code connects to the Chrome browser integration.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not control Claude Code's Chrome integration.

noChrome.title: Disable Chrome integration
noChrome.description: Whether Claude Code explicitly avoids the Chrome browser integration.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not control Claude Code's Chrome integration.

cloud.title: Cloud session
cloud.description: Whether the prompt is executed as a Claude Code cloud session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain runs the installed local Claude Code process.

continue.title: Continue recent session
continue.description: Whether Claude continues the most recent session in the working directory.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resumes only an explicit session identifier.

dangerouslySkipPermissions.title: Skip permissions
dangerouslySkipPermissions.description: Whether all permission checks are bypassed.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps explicit bypass requests through --permission-mode after policy validation.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Debug category selector or switch for Claude Code diagnostics.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Claude Code debug categories.

debugFile.title: Debug file
debugFile.description: Path receiving Claude Code diagnostic logs.

x-captain-option.note: Captain captures the child process streams instead of configuring a native debug file.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Remote cloud environment selected for the session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain runs the local Claude Code environment.

excludeDynamicSystemPromptSections.title: Excluded system prompt sections
excludeDynamicSystemPromptSections.description: Dynamic Claude Code system-prompt sections omitted from the request.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not filter Claude Code's dynamic system prompt.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: Model used if the requested model is overloaded.

x-captain-option.note: Captain performs fallback selection in its provider registry.

file.title: Files
file.description: File resources downloaded and supplied to the conversation at startup.

x-captain-option.note: Captain sends local attachments through its composed prompt rather than file-resource mappings.

forkSession.title: Fork session
forkSession.description: Whether resuming creates a new session identifier.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resumes the requested session in place.

forwardSubagentText.title: Forward subagent text
forwardSubagentText.description: Whether subagent text is forwarded into the parent output stream.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not enable native Claude subagent text forwarding.

fromPr.title: Resume from pull request
fromPr.description: Pull request number whose linked Claude session is resumed.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resumes by session identifier, not pull request.

ide.title: IDE integration
ide.description: Whether Claude Code connects automatically to an available IDE.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not enable Claude Code IDE integration.

includeHookEvents.title: Include hook events
includeHookEvents.description: Whether hook lifecycle events appear in stream-json output.

x-captain-option.note: Captain receives monitoring hooks through generated settings.

includePartialMessages.title: Include partial messages
includePartialMessages.description: Whether partial assistant chunks appear in stream-json output.

x-captain-option.note: Captain parses complete stream-json message events.

inputFormat.title: Input format
inputFormat.description: Format used to parse standard input.

x-captain-option.note: Captain writes plain prompt text to standard input.

name.title: Session name
name.description: Display name assigned to the Claude Code session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not assign a native Claude session name.

noSessionPersistence.title: Disable session persistence
noSessionPersistence.description: Whether Claude Code avoids saving the session to disk.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not override Claude Code session persistence.

permissionPrompts.title: Permission prompts
permissionPrompts.description: Transport used for permission prompts in non-interactive mode.

x-captain-option.note: Captain uses Claude Code's permission mode and tool allow or deny lists.

pluginUrl.title: Plugin URLs
pluginUrl.description: Remote plugin URLs downloaded and loaded for the session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain accepts local skill directories and does not download Claude plugins.

promptSuggestions.title: Prompt suggestions
promptSuggestions.description: Whether Claude emits suggested follow-up prompts.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not request native prompt suggestions.

remoteControl.title: Remote control
remoteControl.description: Whether the local session can be controlled from claude.ai.

x-captain-option.note: Captain owns the local child process and does not enable remote control.

remoteControlSessionNamePrefix.title: Remote session name prefix
remoteControlSessionNamePrefix.description: Prefix used for remote-control session names.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not enable Claude remote-control sessions.

replayUserMessages.title: Replay user messages
replayUserMessages.description: Whether stdin user messages are echoed back into stream-json output.

x-captain-option.note: Captain already owns the canonical input message.

restricted.title: Restricted mode
restricted.description: Whether networking and filesystem access are restricted.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps its explicit permissions instead of enabling this CLI preset.

safeMode.title: Safe mode
safeMode.description: Whether built-in skills, hooks, filesystem MCP servers, and command files are disabled.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps its bare and permission settings separately.

sessionId.title: New session ID
sessionId.description: Explicit UUID assigned to a new Claude Code session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain reads the session identifier emitted by Claude Code.

settingSources.title: Setting sources
settingSources.description: Filesystem setting scopes loaded by Claude Code.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not override Claude Code's settings-source discovery.
Captain sends its system prompt directly.

teleport.title: Teleport session
teleport.description: Whether a remote Claude session is teleported into the local terminal.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not import remote Claude sessions.

tmux.title: Tmux mode
tmux.description: Whether Claude creates a tmux worktree session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain manages its own process and working directory.

tools.title: Tool set
tools.description: Built-in Claude Code tool names made available to the session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps allow and deny policies instead of replacing Claude's tool set.

worktree.title: Worktree
worktree.description: Whether Claude starts in an isolated Git worktree, optionally using a supplied name.

x-captain-option.note: Captain executes in the working directory supplied by its context.

help.title: Help
help.description: Whether Claude Code prints command help and exits.

x-captain-option.note: Captain executes requests rather than CLI help.

version.title: Version
version.description: Whether Claude Code prints its version and exits.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resolves the installed CLI version outside request execution.
